meta.title: fix: update schemaDesignTool to directly update workflow state
meta.body_summary: Eliminate redundant database fetch by making schemaDesignTool return JSON with schema data, allowing invokeSchemaDesignToolNode to update workflow state directly without a separate DB read.

The tool was modified to return an object containing message, schemaData, and latestVersionNumber. Tests were updated to match the new JSON format.
